entities.summary: Mikhail Dmitrievich Levashov was a Russian explorer and Lieutenant of the Imperial Russian Navy. After Vitus Bering's 1741 tragic venture, Peter Kuzmich Krenitzin was among the first to conduct an expedition to Alaska and the Aleutians.
